text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia.

Given your age, the 3-week history of fatigue and bruising, combined with new fever and severe night pain in the legs, these are highly concerning signs of blood cancer.
